items.question: Which are the top 3 products by units sold in orders with the status 'delivered' in 2025? List their names.
items.answer:

JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-%'
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC
LIMIT 3
